sloka: दमः शमः क्षमा धर्मो धृति सत्यम् पराक्रमः ।पर्थिवानाम् गुणा राजन् दण्डः च अपकारिषु ॥४-१७-१९॥
transliteration: damaḥ śamaḥ kṣamā dharmo dhṛti satyam parākramaḥ ।parthivānām guṇā rājan daṇḍaḥ ca apakāriṣu ॥4-17-19॥

translations.english: 'Believing that you are a repository of all these virtues are in you, and respecting your noble lineage I engaged in a duel with Sugriva even though I was forewarned (by Tara).
